why: A call-auction market (fm-server#1036). Read without its mechanism, a call market looks continuous: a robot posts into it expecting crossing orders to trade, they rest instead, and it sees a crossed book it cannot explain.

source.constructed: the fields as fm-server's MarketplaceV1Controller answers them since call auctions (#1036) for a CALL market with an interval and no carry, so all three call fields differ from the defaults.
